description: Defines the ModuleSerializer class responsible for serializing and converting modules within the Google Breakpad crash reporting system. Includes methods for size calculation, serialization, and conversion of module data, and references various related resolver types and serializers.

classes.name: ModuleSerializer
classes.description: Handles serialization and conversion of modules for crash reporting, including size calculation, serialization, and integration with fast resolvers.

methods.name: SizeOf
methods.description: Calculates the memory size needed to serialize a given module.

methods.name: Write
methods.description: Writes a module into a provided memory buffer.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes a module into a heap-allocated memory chunk.

methods.name: SerializeSymbolFileData
methods.description: Converts symbol data string into serialized binary data.

methods.name: ConvertOneModule
methods.description: Serializes a specific module by module ID and loads it into a fast resolver.

methods.name: ConvertAllModules
methods.description: Serializes all modules in a resolver and loads them into a fast resolver.

methods.name: SerializeModuleAndLoadIntoFastResolver
methods.description: Internal method to serialize a module and load it into a fast resolver.
